moments.title: Commonwealth Games in Glasgow Nears End
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games, officially known as Glasgow 2026, is currently underway, running from July 23 to August 2, with the closing ceremony happening this Sunday.

angles.name: Closing Ceremony Buzz
angles.copy: Glasgow 2026 is wrapping up! Who's ready for the closing ceremony this Sunday? Simple Minds are headlining – what a way to go out!

angles.name: Sporting Highlights
angles.copy: From athletics to swimming, the Commonwealth Games have delivered some incredible moments this week. What's been your favourite Glasgow 2026 highlight so far?

angles.name: Scotland's Hosting
angles.copy: Glasgow's done a fantastic job hosting the Commonwealth Games! If you're in Scotland, have you felt the buzz?

moments.title: AIG Women's Open Teeing Off
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open, one of golf's five major championships, starts tomorrow, July 29, and runs until August 2 at Royal Lytham and St Annes in England.

angles.name: Major Golf Starts
angles.copy: It's major championship week for women's golf! The AIG Women's Open begins tomorrow at Royal Lytham and St Annes. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Lancashire Hosts Golf
angles.copy: The world's top women golfers are heading to Royal Lytham and St Annes for the AIG Women's Open, starting Wednesday. A fantastic showcase for Lancashire!

moments.title: Poole Harbour Festival This Weekend
moments.blurb: The Poole Harbour Festival kicks off this Friday, July 31, running until August 2, featuring Kaiser Chiefs, Groove Armada DJ Set, The Fratellis, Scouting For Girls and more.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Three days to go until Poole Harbour Festival! Kaiser Chiefs, Groove Armada, The Fratellis, Scouting For Girls... who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Dance Tent Legends
angles.copy: Ready to hit the dance tent at Poole Harbour Festival? Judge Jules, Lisa Lashes, N-Trance, Artful Dodger are all set to bring the beats!

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Continues in London
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents concert series at Crystal Palace Bowl in London continues this week and through August, featuring acts like Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille, and Lenny Kravitz.

angles.name: London Gigs This Week
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is buzzing! Catch Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille and more performing live this week as part of Palace Bowl Presents.

angles.name: Music Legends Live
angles.copy: From the iconic Tom Jones to the legendary Gary Numan, Crystal Palace Bowl is hosting some serious music royalty this summer! Who's on your must-see list?

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival, combining music and surf, hits Cornwall from August 7-9, with headliners including Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, Tash Sultana, Lily Allen, Pendulum, Kasabian and Rudimental.

angles.name: Cornwall Calling
angles.copy: Only 10 days until Boardmasters! Who's heading to Cornwall for the surf and sounds of Fatboy Slim, The Kooks, Kasabian and more?

angles.name: Festival Lineup
angles.copy: The Boardmasters lineup is stacked! From Lily Allen to Pendulum, there's something for everyone. Which artists are you buzzing to see?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK Singles Chart Top Spot
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the UK Singles Chart #1 for an 18th non-consecutive week, matching Frankie Laine's record. Shakira & Burna Boy are at #2.

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is now tied for the longest-running UK #1 single ever! Incredible achievement.

angles.name: New Music & Classics
angles.copy: This week's chart sees Sam Fender & Olivia Dean at #1, Shakira & Burna Boy at #2, and Oasis's 'Wonderwall' still hanging in the Top 10 after 108 weeks! What a mix.

moments.title: Charli XCX & Snow Patrol Battle for UK Albums Chart #1
moments.blurb: Charli XCX's 'Music, Fashion, Film' is currently leading the race for UK Official Albums Chart #1, with Snow Patrol's 20th anniversary edition of 'Eyes Open' close behind at #2.

angles.name: Album Chart Race
angles.copy: It's a tight race for the UK Albums Chart #1! Will Charli XCX take it, or can Snow Patrol's 'Eyes Open' 20th anniversary edition snatch the top spot?

angles.name: Snow Patrol Anniversary
angles.copy: 20 years of 'Eyes Open'! Snow Patrol's classic album is battling for #1 again. What's your favourite track from the record?

moments.title: Futurama Season 14 Lands on Disney+
moments.blurb: The new season of the beloved animated sci-fi comedy, Futurama, is set to launch on Disney+ UK on Monday, August 3.

angles.name: Good News Everyone!
angles.copy: Good news, everyone! Futurama Season 14 is landing on Disney+ UK next Monday, August 3. Get ready for more space pirates, lab-grown meats, and sci-fi absurdity!

angles.name: Back to the Future
angles.copy: Your favourite 31st-century crew is back! Futurama returns for a new season on Disney+ next week. What are your hopes for Fry, Leela, and Bender?

moments.title: Happy 36th Birthday Soulja Boy
moments.blurb: American rapper Soulja Boy, known for hits like 'Crank That (Soulja Boy)', celebrates his 36th birthday today, July 28.

angles.name: Crank That Birthday
angles.copy: Making waves since 'Crank That', Soulja Boy turns 36 today! What's your favourite track from the rapper?

angles.name: 00s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to Soulja Boy! He definitely defined an era of internet culture and music.

moments.title: Happy 50th Birthday Jacoby Shaddix
moments.blurb: Jacoby Shaddix, the dynamic lead singer of rock band Papa Roach, celebrates his 50th birthday today, July 28.

angles.name: Papa Roach Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 50th Birthday to Jacoby Shaddix, the voice of Papa Roach! What's your go-to Papa Roach anthem?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Jacoby Shaddix of Papa Roach turning 50 today! Still bringing the energy after all these years.

moments.title: Happy 73rd Birthday Geddy Lee
moments.blurb: Geddy Lee, the iconic bassist, vocalist, and keyboardist for legendary rock band Rush, turns 73 tomorrow, July 29.

angles.name: Rush Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we celebrate the 73rd birthday of Rush legend Geddy Lee! What's your favourite Rush track featuring his unmistakable vocals?

angles.name: Prog Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy early 73rd Birthday to Geddy Lee! A true pioneer of progressive rock.
